commentary.text: National Weather Service Coastal Flood Advisory: watch the surf, stay off wet rock near the water, and keep kids close. The water is running higher than predicted, so expect less exposed reef despite the low tide. Go between 2:01 PM and 6:08 PM, but bring a light since the window extends past sunset. With a Coastal Flood Advisory in effect, stay alert to changing conditions and plan your exit before the water rises.

site_hazards.text: Wet algae-covered rocks are slippery
Waves can wash over the outer benches
Rising tide can cut off the rocks below the point
Leave animals, shells, and rocks where you find them
